output.explanation: NIG-SA booked payable NIG-SA:ICV-SA-019069 at GBP 9,405.00 against NIG-UK's receivable NIG-UK:1900045459 of GBP 9,900.00 for the same invoice reference 9000010486. The ratio is 0.95, consistent with Saudi 5% WHT on services, and the buyer description explicitly states 'net of WHT 5%'. The GBP 495.00 gap (USD 619.60 at invoice-date rate) is withholding tax, not a booking error.
output.recommended_action: NIG-SA should gross up the IC payable to GBP 9,900 by recognising the GBP 495 WHT payable to the Saudi tax authority, and provide the WHT certificate to NIG-UK so it can book the tax credit/receivable.
output.adjustment_description: NIG-SA: reclassify GBP 495.00 from the IC payable to NIG-UK into a WHT payable to the Saudi tax authority, so the IC payable equals the gross invoice of GBP 9,900.00. NIG-UK: on receipt of the WHT certificate, reclassify GBP 495.00 from the IC receivable to a WHT tax receivable/expense.
